report_text:
Sensitive-skin shopping hinges on proof — I'm mapping the verified Sephora and Ulta tools your persona would rely on.

I've charted the loyalty structures and clean beauty standards — now digging into try-on tools, samples, and trust signals.

Early findings lean on non-US pages, which don't apply here — I'm refocusing on verified US sources for both retailers.

I've gathered the core feature evidence — now pulling the exact US pages to anchor every claim.

Core US product and policy pages are verified — now capturing the final discovery and loyalty sources.

I've secured the loyalty and safety data — now confirming the ingredient display details to complete the picture.

## 1. Sephora: site features and shopping tools

- Full ingredient disclosure on product detail pages, with Highlighted Ingredients plus full INCI list and note to check packaging for changes. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937))
- Clean at Sephora commitment described as offering effective products without certain ingredients such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates and mineral oils. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937))
- Trending Products curation that frames products taking social media by storm, useful as a cue to verify rather than proof of suitability. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/trending-products))
- Ratings & Reviews displayed with aggregate rating and review count, plus Beauty Insider Community for looks, reviews and Questions & Answers with other shoppers. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937)) ([Beauty Insider Community FAQs](https://community.sephora.com/))
- Virtual Artist augmented-reality try-on that scans selfie image to place lipstick, eyeshadow, highlighter and false lashes. **[Retailer-specific]** ([7 Brands Using Virtual Try-On Tech to Boost Sales](https://www.threekit.com/))
- Auto-Replenish with 5% off, Same-Day Delivery and Buy Online & Pick Up fulfillment choices shown on product pages. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937))
- Beauty Insider free three-tier loyalty program earning 1 point per dollar, with Insider, VIB at $350/year and Rouge at $1,000/year and cash redemptions starting at 500 points for $10 off and Rewards Bazaar samples. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Sephora Beauty Insider: How the Loyalty Program Works in 2026](https://www.99minds.io/blog/sephoras-beauty-insider/))

## 2. Ulta Beauty: site features and shopping tools

- Product pages show Key Ingredients summaries and full Ingredients lists with rating and review count, for example niacinamide and antioxidant listing and 4.5 rating from 22 reviews. **[Retailer-specific]** ([ICONIC LONDON - Filter Fix Prep Set Blur Setting Spray | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/p/filter-fix-prep-set-blur-setting-spray-pimprod2052442?pr_rd_page=2))
- Conscious Beauty at Ulta Beauty transparency framework to identify Clean Ingredients, Cruelty Free, Vegan and Sustainable Packaging brands and products. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Conscious Beauty | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/conscious-beauty/))
- Clean Ingredients pillar defined as brand certification that they comply with Ulta Beauty Made Without List considering human and environmental health impact. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Conscious Beauty | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/conscious-beauty/))
- New Beauty Products / New Arrivals assortment pages plus prestige, drugstore, K-beauty and wellness breadth, enabling familiar versus new comparison in one basket. **[Retailer-specific]** ([New Beauty Products | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/new-beauty-products/))
- GLAMLab virtual try-on in the app for thousands of products including lipsticks, eyeliners, foundations and eyeshadows, plus foundation matching, hair-color try-on and AI skin analysis. **[Retailer-specific]** ([How Ulta Beauty is giving omnichannel retail a fresh face | Google Cloud Blog](https://cloud.google.com/blog/transform/ulta-beauty-reinventing-omnichannel-retail-with-cloud-ai))
- Ulta Beauty Rewards free loyalty program with Member 1 point per $1, Platinum 1.25 at $500/year and Diamond 1.5 at $1,200/year, redeemable from 100 points for $3.00 up to 2,000 points for $125.00. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- Tightened US return window to 30 days for full refund with 31-60 days merchandise credit only, applying to new or gently used products. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Sephora and Ulta tighten returns policies](https://trending.thestreet.com/))

## 3. Retailer-specific evidence on how shoppers discover, evaluate and buy

- Discovery often begins with creator content on TikTok or Instagram, then shoppers head to Google or YouTube to learn about ingredients and compare claims, then to retailer PDPs on Sephora or Ulta to read reviews and check price. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Beauty and Skincare Marketing Trends 2027](https://www.bigeyeagency.com/insights/beauty-and-skincare-marketing-trends-2027))
- 92% of shoppers use ratings and reviews on product pages, making PDP reviews a central evaluation checkpoint at both retailers. **[General beauty retail]** ([Beauty and Skincare Marketing Trends 2027](https://www.bigeyeagency.com/insights/beauty-and-skincare-marketing-trends-2027))
- Social creates early demand while retail media and PDP proof points such as clinical data, ingredient clarity, reviews and dermatologist support shape conversion more than polished brand claims. **[General beauty retail]** ([Beauty and Skincare Marketing Trends 2027](https://www.bigeyeagency.com/insights/beauty-and-skincare-marketing-trends-2027))
- US consumers increasingly prefer dermatologically and scientifically backed formulations over brand authority, trusting dermatologists advice at 57%, consumer reviews at 46% and scientific literature at 42%, versus 26% strongly influenced by brand image. **[General beauty retail]** ([US beauty consumers prioritize ingredient transparency over brand image](https://www.personalcareinsights.com/news/us-beauty-ingredient-trust.html))
- Only 15% fully trust clean beauty claims, so Clean at Sephora and Conscious Beauty badges function as starting filters requiring further ingredient verification. **[General beauty retail]** ([US beauty consumers prioritize ingredient transparency over brand image](https://www.personalcareinsights.com/news/us-beauty-ingredient-trust.html))
- Adverse experiences drive defection: 67% would stop using a favorite if it contained a potentially harmful ingredient, 50% would discontinue and seek safer alternative, and 46% had stopped buying certain brands because of ingredients. **[General beauty retail]** ([US beauty consumers prioritize ingredient transparency over brand image](https://www.personalcareinsights.com/news/us-beauty-ingredient-trust.html))
- Physical trial remains sensory validation, but 92% research online while in brick-and-mortar store, scanning reviews and comparing ingredients on phones. **[General beauty retail]** ([Beauty and Skincare Marketing Trends 2027](https://www.bigeyeagency.com/insights/beauty-and-skincare-marketing-trends-2027))

## 4. How this persona's traits show up at Sephora

- Treats Trending Products as cue only, then verifies full ingredients and Highlighted Ingredients on the PDP before considering novelty, consistent with trend_sensitivity 0.30 and novelty_seeking 0.15. **[Inference]** ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/trending-products)) ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937))
- Filters detailed reviews for irritation, redness, burning or fragrance sensitivity and weighs relevant adverse reports heavily before unfamiliar trial, reflecting research_depth 0.90 and low impulse_buying 0.10. **[Inference]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937))
- Checks Clean at Sephora status but does not treat it as guarantee, cross-checking fragrance disclosure because Clean allows restricted synthetic fragrance under 1% and dermatologists note hypoallergenic has very little meaning. **[Inference]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937)) (["Hypoallergenic" Cosmetics | FDA](http://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/cosmetics-labeling-claims/hypoallergenic-cosmetics))
- Uses Community Q&A and Gallery to find similar-concern peers and asks for tolerability context rather than relying on influencer endorsement, matching influencer_trust 0.25. **[Inference]** ([Beauty Insider Community FAQs](https://community.sephora.com/))
- Prefers repurchase of tolerated familiar option via Auto-Replenish 5% off, requiring stronger verified suitability evidence to switch, expressing brand_loyalty 0.80. **[Inference]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937))
- Rejects hypoallergenic-labeled premium blush if PDP lacks complete fragrance breakdown, because FDA has no federal standards governing hypoallergenic and manufacturers need not submit substantiation. **[Inference]** (["Hypoallergenic" Cosmetics | FDA](http://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/cosmetics-labeling-claims/hypoallergenic-cosmetics))
- Evaluates prestige price without assuming better tolerability, justifying paying more only when transparency plus dermatologist, scientific or detailed reviewer validation confirms suitability, reflecting price_sensitivity 0.55 and prestige_priority 0.15. **[Inference]** ([US beauty consumers prioritize ingredient transparency over brand image](https://www.personalcareinsights.com/news/us-beauty-ingredient-trust.html))

## 5. How this persona's traits show up at Ulta Beauty

- Starts from need or replacement, then inspects Key Ingredients and full Ingredients sections for fragrance, dyes and known irritants before adding to bag. **[Inference]** ([ICONIC LONDON - Filter Fix Prep Set Blur Setting Spray | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/p/filter-fix-prep-set-blur-setting-spray-pimprod2052442?pr_rd_page=2))
- Uses Conscious Beauty Clean Ingredients certification as initial transparency signal, then checks Made Without List compliance and actual formula because certification is brand-attested. **[Inference]** ([Conscious Beauty | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/conscious-beauty/))
- Compares familiar tolerated product against unfamiliar new launch across mass and prestige in same cart, weighing formulation story and clinical proof over price or virality. **[Inference]** ([New Beauty Products | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/new-beauty-products/))
- Treats GLAMLab shade or finish preview as irrelevant to irritation risk and still requires ingredient and review checks, keeping convenience_priority 0.35 subordinate to product_quality_priority 0.85. **[Inference]** ([How Ulta Beauty is giving omnichannel retail a fresh face | Google Cloud Blog](https://cloud.google.com/blog/transform/ulta-beauty-reinventing-omnichannel-retail-with-cloud-ai))
- Defers when PDP shows missing or packaging-may-vary ingredients, or when review cluster reports stinging, rash or eye irritation, consistent with high risk aversion expressed through research and deferral rules. **[Inference]** ([ICONIC LONDON - Filter Fix Prep Set Blur Setting Spray | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/p/filter-fix-prep-set-blur-setting-spray-pimprod2052442?pr_rd_page=2)) ([US beauty consumers prioritize ingredient transparency over brand image](https://www.personalcareinsights.com/news/us-beauty-ingredient-trust.html))
- Consolidates verified repurchases in Ulta Beauty Rewards for value on daily-use cleanser, moisturizer and similar high-exposure categories, since 85% of surveyed categories are used daily by at least one-third and 78% will pay more for safer formulations. **[Inference]** ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all)) ([US beauty consumers prioritize ingredient transparency over brand image](https://www.personalcareinsights.com/news/us-beauty-ingredient-trust.html))

## 6. Sephora versus Ulta Beauty for this persona

- Ingredient transparency mechanics are comparable: both show PDP ingredient sections, but neither was verified to offer irritation-specific review filters, so manual keyword searching for irritation is required in both. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937)) ([ICONIC LONDON - Filter Fix Prep Set Blur Setting Spray | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/p/filter-fix-prep-set-blur-setting-spray-pimprod2052442?pr_rd_page=2))
- Clean signaling differs: Sephora frames as without certain ingredients, Ulta frames as Clean Ingredients plus Cruelty Free, Vegan, Sustainable Packaging and Give Back pillars, neither equating to sensitive-skin suitability. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937)) ([Conscious Beauty | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/conscious-beauty/))
- Assortment breadth favors Ulta for price-anchored comparison of premium sensitive-positioned versus cheaper comparable, while Sephora skews prestige and supports prestige-versus-prestige tolerability comparison. **[Inference]** ([New Beauty Products | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/new-beauty-products/)) ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/trending-products))
- Peer validation differs: Sephora offers Community Q&A and Gallery for detailed peer context, Ulta leans on PDP ratings and broader mass-prestige review volume, both requiring skepticism toward viral claims. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Beauty Insider Community FAQs](https://community.sephora.com/)) ([ICONIC LONDON - Filter Fix Prep Set Blur Setting Spray | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/p/filter-fix-prep-set-blur-setting-spray-pimprod2052442?pr_rd_page=2))
- Try-on relevance is low for this persona in both: Virtual Artist and GLAMLab show color and finish but do not test tolerability or predict irritation. **[Retailer-specific]** ([7 Brands Using Virtual Try-On Tech to Boost Sales](https://www.threekit.com/)) ([How Ulta Beauty is giving omnichannel retail a fresh face | Google Cloud Blog](https://cloud.google.com/blog/transform/ulta-beauty-reinventing-omnichannel-retail-with-cloud-ai))
- Risk buffer is now similar and tighter: both allow 30 days for full refund on gently used products, with Ulta offering 31-60 days merchandise credit, reducing willingness to experiment without verification. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Sephora and Ulta tighten returns policies](https://trending.thestreet.com/))
- Loyalty value favors consolidation after suitability is proven: Sephora converts at 500 points for $10 off, Ulta scales from 100 points for $3.00 to 2,000 points for $125.00, rewarding repeat of tolerated staples rather than driving novelty trial. **[Retailer-specific]** ([Sephora Beauty Insider: How the Loyalty Program Works in 2026](https://www.99minds.io/blog/sephoras-beauty-insider/)) ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))

## 7. Evidence quality and gaps

- Strongest evidence is retailer-owned US PDP and program pages confirming ingredient sections, Clean frameworks, ratings display, try-on and loyalty mechanics. **[General beauty retail]** ([Conscious Beauty | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/conscious-beauty/)) ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- Strong US regulatory evidence clarifies that hypoallergenic has no federal definition and requires no substantiation, directly supporting rejection of unverified safety labeling. **[General beauty retail]** (["Hypoallergenic" Cosmetics | FDA](http://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/cosmetics-labeling-claims/hypoallergenic-cosmetics))
- Strong US survey of 1,700 consumers documents safety over brand image, low trust in clean claims, reliance on dermatologists and reviews, adverse-reaction prevalence and willingness to pay more for safer formulations. **[General beauty retail]** ([US beauty consumers prioritize ingredient transparency over brand image](https://www.personalcareinsights.com/news/us-beauty-ingredient-trust.html))
- Moderate evidence on journey orchestration from US trade press synthesizing PowerReviews, NIQ and creator studies, but figures vary by study and year and were not independently verified. **[General beauty retail]** ([Beauty and Skincare Marketing Trends 2027](https://www.bigeyeagency.com/insights/beauty-and-skincare-marketing-trends-2027))
- No verified evidence found that either retailer offers review filtering by sensitive skin, irritation keywords, or fragrance sensitivity, nor that either discloses full EU fragrance allergens consistently on US PDPs. **[Inference]** ([Aim High Cream Highlighter Stick - LYS Beauty | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/product/lys-beauty-aim-high-cream-highlighter-stick-P511937)) ([ICONIC LONDON - Filter Fix Prep Set Blur Setting Spray | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/p/filter-fix-prep-set-blur-setting-spray-pimprod2052442?pr_rd_page=2))
- No retailer-specific public data found on sensitive-skin segment conversion, returns due to irritation, or dermatologist content effectiveness on Sephora or Ulta. **[Inference]** ([Beauty and Skincare Marketing Trends 2027](https://www.bigeyeagency.com/insights/beauty-and-skincare-marketing-trends-2027))
- Regional Sephora help and product pages were excluded per US-only scope, and return-policy details rely on secondary US press because official policy pages were not retrieved in search. **[General beauty retail]** ([Sephora and Ulta tighten returns policies](https://trending.thestreet.com/))
